import json
trace=[{"step":1,"file":"init.c","function":"parse_jobs_ini","line":2127,"var":"file","code":"return __parse_jobs_ini(NULL, file, is_buf, stonewall_flag, type, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);","note":"The job file path is passed to the INI parser."},{"step":2,"file":"init.c","function":"__parse_jobs_ini","line":1958,"var":"p","code":"if (is_buf) p = strsep(&file, \"\\n\"); else p = fgets(string, OPT_LEN_MAX, f);","note":"The parser reads an attacker-controlled option line."},{"step":3,"file":"init.c","function":"__parse_jobs_ini","line":1962,"var":"opts[num_opts]","code":"opts[num_opts] = strdup(p);","note":"The raw line is stored in the job option vector."},{"step":4,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_options_parse","line":5195,"var":"opts_copy","code":"opts_copy = dup_and_sub_options(opts, num_opts);","note":"The option vector is duplicated before substitution."},{"step":5,"file":"options.c","function":"dup_and_sub_options","line":5150,"var":"opts_copy[i]","code":"opts_copy[i] = fio_keyword_replace(opts_copy[i]);","note":"The duplicated option string is handed to the keyword expander."},{"step":6,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5101,"var":"s","code":"while ((s = strstr(opt, kw->word)) != NULL) {","note":"The expander finds the $ncpus keyword inside the long description field."},{"step":7,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5118,"var":"opt","code":"opt += strlen(kw->word) + olen;","note":"The live pointer is moved past the matched keyword so the remaining suffix starts later in the original buffer."},{"step":8,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5121,"var":"memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1)","code":"if (strlen(opt)) memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","note":"The copy length is computed from the advanced pointer rather than the suffix length, so a long prefix before $ncpus can make memcpy read/write beyond the heap allocation."}]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace))
print('ok')
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json | head -c 500 && echo
